source_title: Shah Rukh Khan's 'King' 'Qaatil Nahi Aashiq Hoon' Poster OUT; Teases New Avatar
source_excerpt:
Shah Rukh Khan is gearing up for his big-screen return with King after the success of his three-film run in 2023. The superstar, whose films Pathaan and Jawan emerged as blockbusters while Dunki was a hit, has kept fans waiting for his next release. Now, the makers have unveiled a new poster of King , offering a glimpse of his striking look and raising excitement around the action entertainer.
ALSO READ: 'Naagin' To Return With A Twist? Ektaa Kapoor Hints At The Franchise's Next Chapter
The latest poster presents Shah Rukh Khan in a fierce yet romantic avatar, with a rose between his lips and an intense look in his eyes. The striking visual hints at the film’s mix of action, intensity and romance, while adding a fresh dimension to the superstar’s on-screen persona.
Accompanying the poster is the line, ‘Kattil nahi.. Aashiq hoon…’ [Not a killer, but a lover], which adds to the intrigue surrounding his character. The larger-than-life presentation has given fans another reason to look forward to seeing Khan return to the big screen in a new role.
Directed by Siddharth Anand, King is produced by Red Chillies Entertainment and Marflix Pictures. The film is scheduled to arrive in cinemas worldwide on 24 December 2026, making it a Christmas release.
With its action-packed presentation and Shah Rukh Khan’s intense new look, the film is already generating anticipation among his fans.
ALSO READ: 'Pratha? Arth?': Amitabh Bachchan Questions Blind Beliefs, Superstitions Passed Down Generations
King will mark the first time Shah Rukh Khan shares screen space with his daughter, Suhana Khan. The film also features Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan, Rani Mukerji, Abhay Verma, Raghav Juyal and Jaideep Ahlawat in important roles.
The combination of an ensemble cast, Siddharth Anand’s direction and Khan’s return to the big screen has made King one of the films to watch out for this Christmas.
King is scheduled to arrive in cinemas worldwide on December 24, 2026. It is set to be a Christmas release.
King is directed by Siddharth Anand. The film is produced by Red Chillies Entertainment and Marflix Pictures.
The film stars Shah Rukh Khan, marking his first time sharing the screen with his daughter, Suhana Khan. It also features Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan, and Rani Mukerji.
